name: agentgauntlet
description: Open benchmark of realistic web scenarios with active anti-agent defenses.

scripts.start: npm run build && concurrently --names landing,cart,payment,bank --prefix-colors blue,cyan,magenta,yellow "npm start --prefix landing" "npm start --prefix cart-checkout" "npm start --prefix payment-checkout" "npm start --prefix bank-login"
scripts.start:dev: concurrently --names landing,cart,payment,bank --prefix-colors blue,cyan,magenta,yellow "npm start --prefix landing" "npm start --prefix cart-checkout" "npm start --prefix payment-checkout" "npm start --prefix bank-login"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix landing && npm install --prefix cart-checkout && npm install --prefix payment-checkout && npm install --prefix bank-login
scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix landing && npm install --prefix cart-checkout && npm install --prefix payment-checkout && npm install --prefix bank-login
